rules.rule: Same series and date delivered twice. Kept: neither until resolved.
No €STR observation on a TARGET2 business day (weekdays excl. 1 Jan, Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, 25–26 Dec). A missing yield-curve day is a WARN: the gap is left blank, never filled.
Any rate outside −1% to 10%. Catches decimal-shift and unit errors (e.g. 3.9 delivered as 390).
€STR more than 50bp away from the ECB deposit facility rate: economically implausible given how €STR is anchored.
Identical value repeated for too many observations (€STR rate 5, yields 3, €STR volume 2), a typical sign of a frozen feed.
Daily change more than 8 robust standard deviations (median/MAD of the last 60 days) from normal and above a size floor (€STR 5bp, yields 15bp). For €STR the ECB policy-rate change is removed first.
Monthly EURIBOR 3M minus monthly average €STR outside −50bp to +100bp.

transforms.name: Parse dates
transforms.rule: All dates converted to ISO 8601. Daily series keep the reference date (the day the rate applies to), not the publication date (€STR is published at 08:00 CET the next business day).

transforms.name: Type & unit
transforms.rule: Values parsed as decimals exactly as delivered: no rounding, no rescaling. Rates stay in % per annum; spreads are converted to basis points only in derived fields.

transforms.name: Calendar alignment
transforms.rule: Every daily series is aligned to the TARGET2 business-day calendar. The ECB deposit rate is forward-filled because a policy rate stays in force until changed. Market series (€STR, yields) are never forward-filled: a missing value stays missing and is flagged.

transforms.name: Derived fields
transforms.rule: €STR − deposit rate spread; 10Y − 2Y curve slope; monthly average €STR; EURIBOR 3M − €STR spread. Each is computed only from fields in the same row/month.

transforms.name: Quality gate
transforms.rule: Values that fail an ERROR check are withheld (left blank) in the published files and logged; they are never silently corrected. WARN values are published with a flag.

transforms.name: Lineage
transforms.rule: Each build stores the raw ECB response, its SHA-256 hash, row count and fetch time, plus hashes of every published file, in manifest.json.
